proposals.title: Implement nominal types and scale constants in packages/core
proposals.why_now: CanonicalEncoder is the only substantive code in packages/core. ADR-003 (TRAVADO) precisely specifies Money, Quantity, Price, Rate as branded bigint types and Tick as a branded safe-integer number. No DEFINIR decision affects these definitions — they are fully specified. Every downstream FASE-1 package (domain/ledger, world/price, application/tick-loop, contracts/DTOs) is blocked at the type level until these exist. They are the shallowest dependency with the widest fan-out.

proposals.title: Write ADR-002 and implement deterministic positional RNG in packages/core
proposals.why_now: ADR-002 is TRAVADO and requires the hash function to be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR — the algorithm is listed as an open DEFINIR in §19 lacunas conhecidas. INV-02 ('consultar price(asset,t) diretamente é igual a chegar em t avançando tick por tick') is described in the spec as the most important test of the project and depends entirely on the positional RNG being stateless and indexable. All six world namespaces (market.trend, market.factor, market.regime, macro.schedule, bot.policy, bot.decision) are blocked until rand() exists. This can be implemented in parallel with IDEA-001.

proposals.title: Write ADR-004 and implement bigint division helpers in packages/core
proposals.why_now: ADR-004 is TRAVADO: every operation that loses precision must declare its rounding mode explicitly, and calling division without a mode is mandated to be a compile-time or lint-blocking error. The enforcement mechanism is an open DEFINIR in §19. The domain ledger cannot implement spot execution, fee calculation, or rounding residue posting (INV-07) without these helpers. Leaving this unresolved allows implicit division to proliferate in domain code before enforcement is in place. Depends on IDEA-001 for the branded types whose division it governs.

proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance requires 'Ledger multi-commodity de dupla entrada' and 'Ordem a mercado, compra e venda spot'. INV-04, INV-05, and INV-06 are FASE-1 acceptance gates that cannot be satisfied without this. The ledger is the prerequisite for every domain operation — spot buy, sell, fee posting, rounding residue — and must exist before the tick loop and StateHash can be implemented. Once IDEA-001 (nominal types) and IDEA-003 (division helpers) are merged, no DEFINIR blocks ledger implementation.

proposals.title: Implement world price generator (two assets, two noise layers) in packages/world
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance requires 'gerador de preço com duas camadas de ruído e dois ativos'. This is the primary consumer of the positional RNG and the entry point to INV-02, described explicitly in the spec as the most important test in the project. Two open DEFINIR decisions must be resolved as part of this task: octave parameters and block periods in a versioned config file (§5.1 DEFINIR), and the fixed-point or lookup-table strategy for log-space price construction (transcendental Math functions are banned by §13 and ADR-003). This task can proceed once IDEA-001 and IDEA-002 are merged.

repository_assessment.current_state: Monorepo infrastructure is complete: CI pipeline, ESLint purity rules, dependency boundary checker, workspace config, and all package stubs are in place. packages/core exports CanonicalEncoder (ADR-009 accepted, 101 tests passing). One ADR is on file (0009-canonical-encoding.md). Every other package — world, domain, application, narrative, contracts, adapters, ui, and all apps/desktop sub-packages — is an empty stub exporting nothing. No nominal types, no positional RNG, no ledger, no price generator, no tick loop, no save system, no CLI replay tool, no benchmark tool, no minimal UI, and no installer exist.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: packages/core is missing the three foundational primitives that every downstream FASE-1 package depends on: (1) branded arithmetic types Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick specified in ADR-003 (no DEFINIR blocks this); (2) deterministic positional RNG rand() required by ADR-002 (DEFINIR: hash algorithm must be written to an ADR); (3) bigint division helpers with explicit rounding modes required by ADR-004 (DEFINIR: enforcement mechanism must be decided). Without these, domain, world, and application all remain unimplementable at the type level.

warnings: No tasks have been accepted since TASK-0009 (canonical encoder). Checkpoints 0034 through 0040 all show NO_ACCEPTED_CHANGES. The proposals in this cycle are identical to those from cycle-000098, cycle-000093, and earlier cycles because the repository state is genuinely unchanged. If the same proposals continue to be generated without acceptance, the block is in the Builder or Reviewer role, not in this analysis.

Three DEFINIR decisions remain simultaneously unresolved and each blocks a distinct FASE-1 delivery chain: (a) hash function algorithm for ADR-002 (positional RNG, blocks world price generator and all namespace consumers), (b) technical enforcement mechanism for division rounding mode (ADR-004, blocks ledger fee and notional calculation), (c) fixed-point or lookup-table strategy for log-space price construction plus octave parameters (§5.1, blocks world price generator). These should be resolved in parallel rather than sequentially to avoid compressing the critical path.

FASE-1 acceptance requires a minimal installer for Windows and Linux (§14.6 TRAVADO: 'instalador mínimo existe na FASE-1, em forma mínima. Não no fim'). No Electron setup, preload, renderer, or electron-builder packaging has been started. The spec explicitly warns that deferring this risks ABI failures and native module rebuild issues in the final week. This risk increases every cycle this work is postponed.
